title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 27
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing crop yield indices in the agriculture sector presents the following data: Wheat: 108, Corn: 95, Rice: 112, Soybeans: 103, Cotton: 89. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: D. The value closest to the overall average
E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret agriculture data on crop yield indices.

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of return rates by product category data (Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret e-commerce data on return rates by product category.

dataContext.data: Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%

visual.title: Return Rates By Product Category — E-Commerce

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing project profitability by industry across consulting categories shows: Technology: 24%, Finance: 31%, Healthcare: 18%, Government: 9%, Retail: 14%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?

E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret consulting data on project profitability by industry.

questions.prompt: Analysis of content viewing patterns in streaming media: Drama: 35%, Comedy: 22%, Documentary: 18%, Action: 15%, Other: 10%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret streaming media data on content viewing patterns.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on supply chain supplier performance scores are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Quality: 87/100, Delivery: 79/100, Price: 83/100, Responsiveness: 91/100, Sustainability: 74/100. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret supply chain data on supplier performance scores.

questions.prompt: Source 1 (Report): fitness gym membership usage shows: Peak hours 6-8am: 42%, 12-2pm: 18%, 5-8pm: 56%, 8-10pm: 23%, Other: 12%. Source 2 (Email): The weakest performer needs a 20% improvement to meet targets. Source 3 (Table): Targets are set at the top-quartile value. Which category needs improvement?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret fitness data on gym membership usage.

questions.prompt: Reviewing cybersecurity records: Source A shows incident response times: Detection: 4.2h, Containment: 2.8h, Eradication: 6.1h, Recovery: 12.4h, Documentation: 3.9h. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret cybersecurity data on incident response times.

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in retail sales quarterly revenue? (1) Q1: $2.4M. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.
options: A. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
B. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
C. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
D. Each statement alone is sufficient
E. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret retail sales data on quarterly revenue.
